summary: Implemented the Decathalon datalist loader. Added monai/data/decathalon_dataloader.py with load_decathalon_datalist (plus private _resolve_path_value helper), an explicit export in monai/data/__init__.py, a "Decathalon DataLoader" tilde-underlined subsection with autofunction in docs/source/data.rst after Utilities, and tests/test_load_decathalon_datalist.py with class TestLoadDecathalonDatalist containing the four specified tests. Line lengths were measured at or under 120 columns. Black and flake8 were not run, and no tests were run, per instructions. Nothing was committed. Choices made: a non-list value under data_list_key raises ValueError; a non-object top-level JSON value reports the key as not found; JSON decode errors propagate as ValueError.
